formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P17-P4 — Frozen Handcrafted-Search Representation Untouched-Fresh Confirmation, Solve-Clustered NLL Margin, Raw-Latent Primary Rival, Hybrid Secondary Comparator, No-Retrain Model-Byte Evaluation, 16-Cell Transport Diagnostics & Representation Confirmation Gate
interpretation: The frozen handcrafted-search representation retains the development-favored direction against frozen raw latent on untouched fresh48, but the presealed bootstrap upper bound crosses zero.
Therefore P17 does not independently confirm HANDCRAFTED_SEARCH superiority over RAW_LATENT.

The frozen HYBRID model has the lowest fresh mean NLL and highest fresh mean top-1 accuracy, reversing the P16-R4 held-out-development ordering; because HYBRID was secondary here, this cannot rescue the P17 primary verdict.
Method-level HAND-minus-RAW margins have opposite signs, indicating representation performance is not composition-invariant on this fresh sample.
boundary: Predictive representation performance is not a cognitive mechanism.
Secondary hybrid and subgroup readouts cannot redefine the primary verdict.
Fresh48 may now be used as development evidence for successor hypothesis generation, but not as fresh confirmation for hypotheses first noticed here.
